name: blockforge
description: Turn a picture into an almost 1:1 stud-style Roblox model. Local BlockBench-style editor + AI pipeline (TRELLIS 3D scans, picture matching, Claude/Gemini builders, MCP) with Roblox .rbxmx export.
author: zielonyxiom

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of ['server/server.js','server/pipeline.js','server/model.js','server/llm.js','server/images.js','server/mesh3d.js','server/roblox.js','server/batch.js','mcp/mcp-server.js','public/app.js','public/mesh.js','public/roblox.js']) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('all files OK')"
